scene_manager_scope.transition_handling: Candidate SPLASH_V3_MENU_HANDOFF: frame-240 request waits for fade and DMA drain, manager owns a 12-frame input/update/nested-transition lock, menu fade-in, then unlock; compiled runtime proof pending.

transition_pattern.fallback: Hard cut if fade cannot progress; not implemented.

input_abstraction_scope.abstraction_layer: No scene input during the 240-frame splash. In menu-handoff candidate, APP_update retains scene-transition ownership and blocks menu input/update for 12 frames after entry.
supported_devices: Mega Drive joypad ignored during splash

transitions.trigger: Handoff profile: nominal frame 240, after PAL fade idle and DMA queue empty; menu update/input unlock after 12 frames. Preview profile remains on A: REVER.

memory_pool_map.lifecycle: Static candidate capacity for density inputs; runtime capacity is not selected until measurement.
Created at frame 180 and removed at frame 210; candidate count, not runtime proof.

sprite_engine_constraints.argument_semantics: VRAM tile reservation, not number of Sprite instances
sprite_engine_constraints.remaining_limits: The 80-link total and H40 limits of 20 links and 320 pixels per scanline still apply.

vblank_dma_ownership.safety_pattern: Preload only in scene entry through the application VBlank path. Per-frame palette updates and any queued transfer must be confirmed against SGDK 2.11 and measured before runtime.

h_int_ownership.singleton_owner: none; no H-Int effect is selected

channel_owners: branding_v3_music_director owns the XGM2 background loop; physical channel assignment pending audio architecture card
branding_v3_sound_director owns rise, lock, sweep, and tail cues; PCM overlap policy pending audio architecture card

region_timing_scope.justification: The 240-frame timing proposal is NTSC-specific. PAL adaptation is future architectural work.

technique_selection.selection_rationale: The selected techniques directly cover the proposed particle motion, safe resource loading, palette states, indexed tile reuse, and XGM2 event ownership.
technique_selection.fallback_strategy: Reduce or simplify only after measuring the worst candidate frame; never use flicker, out-of-VBlank DMA, or unowned CRAM writes.

rejected_or_deferred.reason: The current choreography reuses the same legal sprite population and does not plan flicker or time-sliced SAT overcommit.
rejected_or_deferred.reconsideration_gate: Only if all-frame measurement shows pressure that a static allocation cannot resolve.

rejected_or_deferred.reason: The sweep is a seven-segment moving band, not a slot-overcommit system; its ordinary sprite geometry still requires measurement.
rejected_or_deferred.reconsideration_gate: Revisit if measured pressure requires per-band slot arbitration.

rejected_or_deferred.reason: No raster effect or mid-frame palette write is part of the selected direction.
rejected_or_deferred.reconsideration_gate: Reopen only with a new scene-direction decision and singleton/reset plan.

rejected_or_deferred.reason: The cutscene exits through a timed palette fade and explicit teardown without H-Int choreography.
rejected_or_deferred.reconsideration_gate: Reopen only if transition direction adds a measured raster effect.

rejected_or_deferred.reason: The human choice between hand-authored pixels and an ImageGen-authored master is pending.
rejected_or_deferred.reconsideration_gate: Select the source-specific art standard after the lettering route is approved.

application_plan.gameplay_or_narrative_purpose: Make blue particles expand and contract around the central mark without floating point math.
application_plan.visual_or_audio_role: Same numeric motion; opt-in ROM coordinate tables remove repeated per-frame curve calculations.
application_plan.budget_evidence: out/logs/splash_v3_motion_lut_compiled_equivalence_20261016.json and out/evidence/splash_v3_motion_lut_v002_20261016/native_cadence_01/cadence_observation.json; 25296 bytes, all coordinate pairs verified; sustained 60fps still unproven.
application_plan.fallback: Retain unchanged integer C reference with SPLASH_V3_MOTION_LUT undefined. The r1 anchor experiment always uses reference energy math.

application_plan.scene_or_system: scene resource entry and palette updates
application_plan.gameplay_or_narrative_purpose: Keep resource handoff safe while the splash owns the display.
application_plan.visual_or_audio_role: Prevent visible transfer stalls and out-of-VBlank writes.
application_plan.budget_evidence: Load envelope, per-frame envelope, and worst-frame VBlank fit are pending.
application_plan.fallback: Defer uploads to entry or reduce the resident set after measurement.

application_plan.scene_or_system: SGDK outline, fill, and final fade
application_plan.gameplay_or_narrative_purpose: Make the mark progress from luminous outline to filled lockup without redrawing pixels.
application_plan.visual_or_audio_role: Use ordered CRAM states as the reveal and exit motion.
application_plan.budget_evidence: Palette ownership, transfer path, and all state changes await API review and runtime measurement.
application_plan.fallback: Keep one readable filled state and use a simple tested fade.

application_plan.gameplay_or_narrative_purpose: Protect reserved operator slots while assigning color roles to the two wordmarks.
application_plan.visual_or_audio_role: Keep authored luminance ramps distinct from Shadow/Highlight operator colors.
application_plan.budget_evidence: Slot reservation audit is pending until palette assets exist.
application_plan.fallback: Do not enable Shadow/Highlight for this scene.

application_plan.gameplay_or_narrative_purpose: Assign roles to environment, FX, SGDK, and FORGE colors before art is finalized.
application_plan.visual_or_audio_role: Remove dead colors and preserve legibility across outline, fill, and sweep states.
application_plan.budget_evidence: Per-material slot audit and remap report are pending until source pixels exist.
application_plan.fallback: Reduce palette complexity while keeping each plate readable.

application_plan.gameplay_or_narrative_purpose: Allow authored background motifs to reuse mirrored tiles when their shapes permit.
application_plan.visual_or_audio_role: Reduce duplicate tile storage without changing source pixels.
application_plan.budget_evidence: Tilemap flip flags and collision-free indices are pending asset conversion.
application_plan.fallback: Keep distinct tiles where mirroring damages composition.

application_plan.gameplay_or_narrative_purpose: Measure normal and mirrored 8x8 tiles before closing the scene residency budget.
application_plan.visual_or_audio_role: Keep the background vocabulary small while preserving original authored composition.
application_plan.budget_evidence: Unique-tile, savings, flag, and index-collision reports await candidate assets.
application_plan.fallback: Reauthor the backdrop with deliberate tile variety if dedup is weak.

application_plan.gameplay_or_narrative_purpose: Give energy, lock, sweep, and tail events clear ownership alongside the loop.
application_plan.visual_or_audio_role: Tie sound changes to narrative beats without masking the visual timing.
application_plan.budget_evidence: Channel map, sample audit, and simultaneous-play proof are pending.
application_plan.fallback: Remove secondary PCM cues and retain the loop plus one lock accent.

application_plan.gameplay_or_narrative_purpose: Keep loop, cues, pause, stop, and scene exit in one deterministic audio owner.
application_plan.visual_or_audio_role: Make the soundtrack support silence, energy rise, mark lock, sweep, and handoff.
application_plan.budget_evidence: Audio architecture card, seamless-loop report, and BlastEm audio proof are pending.
application_plan.fallback: Use a short loop with no overlapping PCM until ownership is proven.
